verdict.rationale: Device pairing or explicit approval is a fair question for a remote-desktop product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack has nothing showing that TeamViewer requires a new device to be paired or approved before it can view or control a screen. The 'managed devices' assignment (teamviewer-docs-29) is an administrative inventory feature, not an access-approval gate, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, a new device must be paired or explicitly approved before it can see or control the screen
